name: Recruitment
description: Fictional hiring policies, a job description and a recruiter guide for Northwind Talent Co., with stale-version, unanswerable and distractor traps.
risk_rules: Never quote a superseded hiring policy (Version 1) as current.
Do not invent salary figures, bonus amounts or deadlines that are not in the documents.
Do not answer hiring questions with employee benefits rules (relocation allowance, resignation notice, annual bonus).
Say the documents do not cover a question instead of guessing, especially on legal topics such as visas.

test_cases.question: What is the salary band for the Senior Data Analyst role?

gold.quote: The salary band for this role is $62,000 to $78,000 per year.

test_cases.question: How many days per week must a Senior Data Analyst work from the office, and is any day mandatory?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: At least 3 days per week in the Pune office, with Tuesday as a mandatory office day

gold.quote: Employees in this role must work from the Pune office at least 3 days per week, and Tuesday is a mandatory office day for the whole team.

test_cases.question: Within how many business days must recruiters screen a new application?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Within 3 business days of receiving it

gold.quote: Recruiters must screen every new application within 3 business days of it being received.

test_cases.question: How soon after an interview must an interviewer submit their scorecard?

gold.quote: Interviewers must submit their scorecard within 24 hours of the interview.

test_cases.question: Which topics are recruiters never allowed to ask candidates about?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Age, marital status, pregnancy or family plans, religion, and caste

gold.quote: Recruiters must never ask candidates about their age, marital status, pregnancy or family plans, religion, or caste.

test_cases.question: What is the time limit for the SQL take-home assignment, and how long is the case study panel?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: 48 hours for the take-home assignment; the case study panel lasts 60 minutes

gold.quote: The SQL take-home assignment has a time limit of 48 hours from when it is sent.

test_cases.note: Needs two facts from the same chunk (the 60-minute panel is in the next sentence).

test_cases.question: How many years of relevant experience are required for senior roles such as the Senior Data Analyst?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience

gold.quote: Senior roles, including the Senior Data Analyst role, require a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience.

stale.quote: Senior roles, including the Senior Data Analyst role, require a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.

test_cases.question: How much is the employee referral bonus when a referred candidate is hired?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: $3,000, once the referred hire completes probation

gold.quote: The referral bonus is $3,000 for each referred candidate who is hired and completes probation.

stale.quote: The referral bonus is $2,000 for each referred candidate who is hired and completes probation.

test_cases.question: How many days does a candidate have to accept a written offer before it expires?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: 5 calendar days after it is sent

gold.quote: A written offer expires 5 calendar days after it is sent if the candidate has not accepted it.

stale.quote: A written offer expires 7 calendar days after it is sent if the candidate has not accepted it.
